subject: Opt-in same-executor ordinary B1 exact decode checkpoint and resume for capability-owned KV and recurrent state
origin: Original MLX2 implementation; no peer source copied. Built on current GenerationBatch ownership, native cache safetensors serialization and the retained I/O ownership mechanism recorded in peer-survey-io-resilience-20261015.json.
modifications: Keep the complete ordinary GenerationBatch control plane: already sampled next token/logprobs, lane RNG, callable sampler/processors, stop matcher prefix, token context, counters and execution width. Park only exact evaluated BatchKVCache backing state.

Store immutable cache bytes in a private unlinked TemporaryFile through one bounded I/O owner. Admit two payload windows plus bounded safetensors header allowance; retain descriptors/payloads until timed-out workers drain, and refuse replacement while ownership remains.

Bind restore to the originating BatchGenerator, model identity, request/revision/cache key and ordinary B1 SDPA numerical law. Verify staged bytes digest and complete cache geometry, then attach the original control object without a constructor/prompt-tail forward or RNG reconstruction.

Stage the empty executor before capture; restore exact state if ledger detach fails. If rollback fails, terminate the affected lane. Cancelled queued checkpoints and server-owned corrupt/failed restores close ownership and return cancellation/503 without orphaning the worker.

Add explicit server memory_preemption.exact_decode_checkpoint=false policy. Only capability-supported ordinary width-one routes opt in; all decode prompt replay remains refused. Pressure-triggered B1 capture is reachable as well as diagnostic fault injection.

Separate exact checkpoint/resume counts from replay counts and expose implemented/selected/observed-used/qualified route receipt state. Make initial/resume lane-attachment metrics best effort with a dedicated failure counter so telemetry cannot terminate an attached live lane.

Extend eligibility through cache-owned contracts rather than model names. Exact base ArraysCache recurrent state and exact BatchKVCache SDPA state each declare capture/restore behavior; speculative rollback state, cache subclasses, non-SDPA KV and right-padded KV remain refused.

Make checkpoint byte admission and geometry validation recursive across nested recurrent state, including exact list/tuple/mapping structure, array shapes and dtypes. Restore reconstructs recurrent host mirrors and the KV padding/backend contract only after digest and full geometry validation.

mixed_cache_cpu_follow_up.scope: Tiny Qwen3.8-style four-layer hybrid model with both ArraysCache and BatchKVCache. Greedy and temperature-0.8 sampled arms each resumed nine times across a 256-token KV allocation boundary with exact tokens, full logprobs, RNG draw count, pending sample and control identity. Server fault injection observed the capability-owned route receipt. Cancelled and digest-corrupt mixed checkpoints closed their descriptors and the emptied executor accepted a fresh request. Active speculative recurrent state is refused before capture; a changed recurrent-cache contract is refused while retaining the exact checkpoint for a successful retry.

limits: Same-process, same-executor, width-one ordinary SDPA with exact base BatchKVCache and base ArraysCache only. No process-restart, cache subclasses, rotating/ring, native-paged, speculative rollback state, multimodal, LoRA, persistent activation-input, approximate-cache or cohort checkpoint support is claimed.

Private spill requires admitted serialization/restore headroom; capture declines safely if its staging window cannot fit. It retains small request/control objects in memory and is not an entirely memory-free suspension.

The tiny CPU/Metal evidence demonstrates this mechanism and numerical continuation. The mixed-cache extension has CPU evidence only; the complete Qwen3.8-27B artifact still requires an owned M3 long-context, repeated pressure/suspend, greedy/sampled and failure-cleanup run. No full-artifact qualification, performance, arbitrary model behavior or broader lane widths is claimed. The route remains unqualified and default-off.

An uninterruptible syscall is not cancelled. Its owner remains quarantined until return. Caller waits for payload I/O and worker draining are bounded; an underlying worker may remain retained indefinitely. Final descriptor close remains synchronous, so universal bounded shutdown is not claimed.
